name: Quick Chicken Cacciatore with Basmati Rice

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cups water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
0.341 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Halve, seed, and cut the bell peppers lengthwise into strips. Transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Slice the mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the bowl.
Pat dry the chicken; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned (but not cooked through), 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the vegetables to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the tomatoes, olives, and half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ cups Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Return the chicken to the skillet and sink into the sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook until chicken is cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.
Divide the rice between plates and top each with the chicken cacciatore. Garnish with the remaining parsley and enjoy!
